examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Single-select with four flat options at large size.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Select from '@aziontech/webkit/select'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const value = ref('')
  const options = [
    { value: 'opt-1', label: 'Option 1' },
    { value: 'opt-2', label: 'Option 2' },
    { value: 'opt-3', label: 'Option 3' },
    { value: 'opt-4', label: 'Option 4' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Select
    aria-label="Option"
    v-model="value"
    size="large"
    placeholder="Select an option"
  >
    <Select.Trigger />
    <Select.Content>
      <Select.Option
        v-for="o in options"
        :key="o.value"
        :value="o.value"
        >{{ o.label }}</Select.Option
      >
    </Select.Content>
  </Select>
</template>

examples.name: Transparent
examples.summary: `kind="transparent"`: no border or fill until hover, sized to its value and set like a breadcrumb crumb. The environment switcher that ends a resource's breadcrumb; the panel keeps a readable minimum width instead of the trigger's.
